entries.title: Ezekiel 2:1
segments: I will speak unto thee; the prophet now receives his commission.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:3
segments:
vv 3-5. 
 
God's servants must deliver his messages to the rebellious and stiff-hearted, as well as to the obedient; not omitting any part of them through fear of persecution, but holding themselves ever ready after the example of their great Master, to suffer reproach and persecution for their fidelity to the truth.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:6
segments: Wicked men show their enmity to God's truth by persecuting those who proclaim it: the faithful preacher must expect to find them briers and thorns in his side and scorpions in his path; but if he puts his trust in God and does his duty, he will be delivered from all their evil devices.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:9
segments: A roll of a book; a book in the form of a roll, after the ancient custom.

entries.title: Ezekiel 2:10
segments:
Spread it; by unrolling it. 
 
  Within and without; that is, on both sides, to denote the fulness of its contents.  Compare

.  Rolls were generally written only on the inner side. 
 
For those who persist in sin, God has no messages but those of evil.
